_groups.Ironfake: Ironfake variant: an Exotic, Poor Quality bootleg of the listed original. Every BODY requirement of the original goes up by 1. Can't be bought through the Edgerunners Mission Kit option of paying double to skip the Fixer. Unless stated here, it keeps the original's rules.
_groups.Darkhound: Darkhound variant: a Barghest-modified version of the listed original. It ablates 1 extra SP whenever it would ablate armor. Ammo bought for it costs double, is one Price Category higher, and only fits the weapon it was bought for. Unless stated here, it keeps the original's rules.

variants.heading: ARA-SAKE MAMA-YURI
variants.class: Exotic Poor Quality Very Heavy Pistol
variants.rules: Its own Armor-Piercing ammo costs 10eb (Everyday) per 10 and only fits this weapon; it can load AP despite being Exotic.

variants.heading: ARA-SAKE NO-WALKING
variants.rules: No Autofire. Every shot fires a 3-round burst, and armor ablation increases by 1 SP.

variants.heading: BANG BAO GG-69 LEON
variants.attachments: Autoloader, Smart Rebuild, SMG Cyclic Internals (SMG 4)
variants.rules: Folds or unfolds as an Action; folded, it's concealable but can't fire.

variants.heading: MECHROMATICA HURRICANE
variants.rules: The magazine can hold up to 5 ammo types at once; choose per shot. Reloading takes 3 Actions.

variants.heading: MILITIATECH TYCOON
variants.rules: Every shot fires a 3-round burst. While the Tech Rebuild is charged it's ROF 1 and deals 4d6. (Corgo describes this as +1d6, but the base Ticon is 2d6, so check the total with your GM.) +2 to Conceal/Reveal Object checks to hide it under clothing.

variants.heading: MILITIATECH N32 HUGE-MAN-GUN
variants.rules: Autofire (Machine Gun 5) and Suppressive Fire only, each using 20 rounds. Needs BODY 12+ to wield unless mounted; without BODY 14+ the wielder takes -2 MOVE. Reloading takes 3 Actions.

variants.heading: RUST-ON-IT TB-2 CLEAVER
variants.rules: Holds 2 rounds, and nothing can increase that. Each barrel can hold a different ammo type; choose which to fire.

variants.heading: HANSEN ARMORY M2070 SOLDIER
variants.attachments: Extended Magazine, Power Rebuild, Shotgun Rechamber, Sling, Tactical Light

variants.heading: HANSEN ARMORY MAULER
variants.attachments: Power Rebuild, Shotgun Choke, Shotgun Rechamber, Sling, Tactical Light
variants.rules: Fired with the Handgun skill. Shotgun Shells deal 4d6 (Shotgun Rechamber).

variants.heading: HANSEN ARMORY M227 FREEMAN
variants.attachments: Foregrip, Folding Structure, Heavy Barrel, Power Rebuild, Sling, SMG Cyclic Internals (SMG 4), SMG Short Barrel
variants.rules: Counts as Excellent Quality when held two-handed (Foregrip). Its Armor-Piercing ammo costs 60eb (Premium) per 10.

variants.heading: HANSEN ARMORY M-77 PRIVATE
variants.attachments: Pistol Long Barrel, Tech Rebuild, Zenith
variants.rules: Once charged, the Tech Rebuild stays charged until the end of a Turn in which it fires; while charged it stays ROF 2 and every attack fires a 3-round burst. Extra ablation totals +1 SP uncharged and +2 SP charged, Darkhound bonus included. +1 to the attack check on its first Single Shot in combat (Zenith).

variants.heading: HANSEN ARMORY M262s TROJAN
variants.rules: In Single Shot you may fire 2 extra rounds as a burst so every round fired counts as Armor-Piercing (Burst Mod Internals). This stacks with the Darkhound ablation bonus.

variants.heading: HANSEN ARMORY PYTHON
variants.attachments: Carbine Barrel, Constant Recoil System (Machine Gun 3), Foregrip
variants.rules: Single Shot deals 4d6. Autofire is rated Machine Gun 3 (Constant Recoil System). Counts as Excellent Quality when held two-handed (Foregrip).

variants.heading: HANSEN ARMORY WENDIGO
variants.attachments: Infrared Nightvision Scope, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Tech Rebuild
variants.rules: Its Tech Rebuild shows rough target outlines through one layer of Thin or Thick Cover, and while charged it fires through one such layer. Extra ablation totals +1 SP uncharged and +2 SP charged, Darkhound bonus included.

variants.heading: HANSEN ARMORY CHUPACABRA
variants.attachments: Battle Barrel, Foregrip, Power Rebuild, Sniping Scope
variants.rules: Deals 6d6, dropping the lowest die. Held two-handed, +1 to Aimed Shots (EQ + Foregrip).
